title: Specify the national implementation package and profile template
requirements:
- List the minimum artefacts a country should produce
- Cover terminology packages, security, versioning, errors, subscriptions, bulk exchange and non-functional requirements
- Recommend resources for linking care, research and biospecimen data
- Define the relationship from reference profile to national profile, IG, vendor implementation and conformance statement
- Add a deliverables matrix by stage; point to a companion technical guide for detail
